description.zh: 快速左右晃动鼠标时在指针位置显示一圈涟漪动效，帮助找回光标；也提供 mouse 关键字手动触发、开关检测和诊断
description.en: Show a ripple at the pointer when the mouse is shaken quickly, so a lost cursor is easy to spot; the mouse keyword triggers it manually and toggles detection

description.zh: 手动显示定位涟漪、开关晃动检测、复制诊断信息；全部只读，按了键才有副作用
description.en: Show the ripple manually, toggle shake detection, copy diagnostics; read-only until a key is pressed

hint.zh: 留空列出全部；Enter 显示涟漪，Ctrl+Enter 开关晃动检测，Shift+Enter 复制诊断
hint.en: empty lists all; Enter shows the ripple, Ctrl+Enter toggles detection, Shift+Enter copies diagnostics

title.zh: 开启 / 关闭晃动检测

hint.zh: Ctrl+Enter 切换会立即生效并保存到这里
hint.en: the Ctrl+Enter toggle takes effect at once and is saved here

hint.zh: 2–8 次，默认 6 次；越大越难误触发
hint.en: 2–8, default 6; higher means fewer false triggers

hint.zh: 80–2000 毫秒，默认 400 毫秒；最近的换向必须落在该时间内
hint.en: 80–2000 ms, default 400 ms; the newest reversals must fit in it

hint.zh: 2–600 像素，默认 80 像素；单次行程小于该幅度的移动被忽略
hint.en: 2–600 px, default 80 px; strokes shorter than this are ignored

hint.zh: 0–20000 像素/秒，默认 1000；行程峰值速度低于该值被视为拖动而非晃动，0 关闭门槛
hint.en: 0–20000 px/s, default 1000; strokes whose peak speed is below this are treated as drags, 0 disables the gate

hint.zh: 0–10000 毫秒，默认 1500 毫秒；冷却期内不重复触发
hint.en: 0–10000 ms, default 1500 ms; no re-trigger while it lasts

hint.zh: 涟漪/水波/光晕/雷达为内置样式；声呐/心跳/轨道为预设样式；自定义使用下方 JSON
hint.en: ring/waves/halo/radar are built-in; ping/heart/orbit are presets; custom uses the JSON below

hint.zh: 0–60000 毫秒，默认 3000 毫秒；超时后信标自动淡出，0 = 不自动消失、一直跟随直到按下左/右键
hint.en: 0–60000 ms, default 3000 ms; the beacon fades out after the timeout; 0 = never auto-dismiss and follow until a left/right click

hint.zh: 0–3000 毫秒，默认 400 毫秒；按下左/右键或自动消失后信标逐渐淡出，0 = 立即消失
hint.en: 0–3000 ms, default 400 ms; after a left/right click or the auto-dismiss the beacon fades out gradually; 0 = vanish at once

hint.zh: 200–3000 毫秒，默认 700 毫秒；内置样式及未写 loopMs 的自定义样式使用；声呐/心跳/轨道使用固定周期
hint.en: 200–3000 ms, default 700 ms; built-ins and custom styles without loopMs use this; Ping/Heartbeat/Orbit have fixed cycles

hint.zh: 24–256 像素，默认 64（96 dpi 基准，随系统缩放）
hint.en: 24–256 px, default 64 (96 dpi reference, scales with display scaling)

hint.zh: #RRGGBB 或 #RGB，默认 #2AA8FF；JSON 里的 "accent" 也指向它
hint.en: #RRGGBB or #RGB, default #2AA8FF; the JSON's "accent" resolves to it

hint.zh: 选择“自定义”时生效，语法见 README；解析失败保留上一有效自定义样式，无历史时用圆环；清空会清除回退样式
hint.en: used for Custom; see README for syntax; invalid JSON keeps the last valid custom style or falls back to Ring; clearing resets the fallback
